## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Japanese Tang-pilgrim importation catalog** by **Enchin** 圓珍, fourth of his five catalogs. The work is a **comprehensive** importation catalog summarizing Enchin's entire Tang acquisitions across his various study locations (Chángān Qīnglóngsì, Chángān Kāiyuánsì, Tāizhōu, Wēnzhōu, Fúzhōu) — the comprehensive form of the more focused individual catalogs ([KR6s0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0116)–[KR6s0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0118)). Preserved at T55 no. 2172. *notBefore* = **858**, *notAfter* = **858**. Catalog dynasty 日本.
